body:
# Amanda Burns

# Vice Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/burns-profile.png)

- Opposed Gov Youngkin’s model policies on transgender students that prohibited boys in girls’ locker rooms and bathrooms. Said: “I firmly support the policy adopted by Charlottesville City Schools on September 1, 2022, “**[Treatment of Transgender and Non-Binary Students](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CPkrzFCvQZpHg3_wrZs4cImSUb_mrov4lh4iPlFDtuA/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.gjdgxs)**.”
- Regarding the influx of immigrant students, **[said she](https://web.archive.org/web/20240912183616/https:/www.cvilletomorrow.org/qa-with-the-4-candidates-seeking-the-4-seats-on-the-charlottesville-city-school-board/)** was “delighted to witness the continuous evolution of cultural diversity within our city over the past few years.” Another board member said the number of immigrant students increased from 5% to 20% in two years.
